name: ChatGPT
tagline: General-purpose conversational AI assistant for writing, coding, and research.
definition: ChatGPT is a flagship conversational artificial intelligence model developed by OpenAI, capable of generating human-like text, writing code, analyzing data, and processing multimodal inputs. It serves as a versatile interface for natural language reasoning and creative brainstorming across professional domains.
why_it_matters: As the catalyst for the modern generative AI wave, ChatGPT set the benchmark for consumer and enterprise AI chat interfaces. Its rapid adoption transformed workplace workflows, forcing organizations globally to integrate conversational LLM capabilities into daily operations.
workplace_use_cases: Drafting and editing emails, executive reports, and technical documentation
Brainstorming campaign concepts and structuring project proposals
First-pass code debugging, syntax translation, and script writing
Analyzing uploaded PDF documents, spreadsheets, and data tables
how_to_use: Navigate to chatgpt.com, log in or sign up for an account, and enter standard natural language prompts or upload document files to start generating responses.
key_features: Multimodal input analysis (text, vision, audio, files)
GPT-4o reasoning and deep web search browsing
Custom GPT creation and workspace team collaboration
Advanced Data Analysis (Python execution in sandbox)

pricing.free_tier_details: Free access to standard GPT-4o mini with rate limits and standard web browsing.

paid_plans.name: Plus
paid_plans.notes: Access to GPT-4o, higher rate limits, DALL-E image generation, and custom GPTs.

paid_plans.name: Team
paid_plans.notes: Shared workspace, admin controls, and no training on workspace data.

paid_plans.name: Enterprise
paid_plans.notes: Unlimited high-speed GPT-4o, enterprise security, SOC2 compliance, and dedicated support.

name: Claude
tagline: AI assistant engineered for safe, highly nuanced reasoning, coding, and long-context analysis.
definition: Claude is Anthropic's flagship AI assistant, widely praised for its exceptional writing quality, code generation, and complex reasoning capabilities. It utilizes Constitutional AI principles to deliver trustworthy, nuanced, and detailed analysis across large volumes of text.
why_it_matters: Claude is renowned for its 200k+ token context window and industry-leading performance on coding and detailed writing tasks. It provides professionals with exceptional precision and artifacts side-panel editing, making it a primary choice for engineers and researchers.
workplace_use_cases: Refactoring complex software repositories and writing automated unit tests
Synthesizing lengthy research papers, legal contracts, and financial earnings reports
Drafting polished long-form editorial copy and technical documentation
Creating interactive UI prototypes directly in the Artifacts side panel
how_to_use: Sign up at claude.ai, start a new chat, paste code snippets or upload files up to 200k tokens, and use Artifacts to view rendered UI components or code blocks side-by-side.
key_features: Claude 3.5 Sonnet & Haiku models with high benchmark scores
Artifacts feature for side-by-side code rendering and document editing
200,000 token context window for processing entire repositories or books
Projects feature for custom knowledge bases and team sharing

pricing.free_tier_details: Free access to Claude 3.5 Sonnet with daily message quotas.

paid_plans.name: Pro
paid_plans.notes: 5x usage allowance compared to free tier, priority access during peak traffic, and Projects feature.

paid_plans.name: Team
paid_plans.notes: Minimum 5 seats, higher usage limits, expanded context sharing, and admin user controls.

name: Gemini
tagline: Natively multimodal AI assistant deeply integrated with Google Workspace and search.
definition: Gemini is Google's multimodal AI model built ground-up to understand text, image, audio, video, and code seamlessly. It directly integrates with Google Workspace applications like Docs, Drive, Gmail, and Sheets to assist daily office productivity.
why_it_matters: Gemini stands out due to its massive 1M+ token context window in advanced tiers and native integration into the ubiquitous Google ecosystem. It enables enterprise workers to query company Drive files and execute cross-app workflows without leaving their workspace.
workplace_use_cases: Summarizing long Google Docs, email threads in Gmail, and Drive presentations
Analyzing long video recordings or audio files to extract key timestamps and action items
Cross-referencing real-time web search results with structured internal documents
Generating initial drafts for Gmail responses and Google Slides presentations
how_to_use: Visit gemini.google.com or use Gemini extensions inside Google Docs and Gmail to invoke AI assistance directly in your document workflows.
key_features: Native multimodal comprehension (video, audio, image, text)
1,000,000+ token context window in Gemini Advanced
Deep Workspace extensions (@Gmail, @Drive, @Docs integration)
Google Search groundings for real-time fact checking

pricing.free_tier_details: Free access to standard Gemini model with web search grounding.

paid_plans.name: Google One AI Premium
paid_plans.notes: Access to Gemini Advanced (Gemini 1.5 Pro model), 2TB storage, and Gemini in Docs/Gmail.

paid_plans.name: Gemini for Workspace
paid_plans.notes: Enterprise add-on for Google Workspace with commercial data protection.

name: Microsoft Copilot
tagline: Enterprise AI assistant integrated across Microsoft 365, Windows, and web search.
definition: Microsoft Copilot combines OpenAI model capabilities with Microsoft's enterprise graph data. It functions across Windows, Bing, and the entire Microsoft 365 suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams) to automate document creation and data analysis.
why_it_matters: Copilot bridges conversational AI directly into corporate enterprise IT environments. With commercial data protection and deep Office suite embedding, it allows enterprise organizations to leverage LLMs safely within existing compliance boundaries.
workplace_use_cases: Generating automated meeting summaries and task lists in Microsoft Teams
Creating financial charts, formulas, and data trends directly in Excel
Transforming Word documents into formatted PowerPoint presentations
Drafting email replies and summarizing long threads in Outlook
how_to_use: Access copilot.microsoft.com or click the Copilot icon inside any Microsoft 365 application (Word, Excel, Teams) to trigger inline workspace prompts.
key_features: Commercial data protection (user data is not used to train base models)
Microsoft 365 Graph integration for searching corporate SharePoint and emails
Excel formula generation and automated slide design in PowerPoint
Web browsing grounded by Bing search engine

pricing.free_tier_details: Free version with web search and basic chat at copilot.microsoft.com.

paid_plans.name: Copilot Pro
paid_plans.notes: Priority access during peak hours and integration with personal Office apps.

paid_plans.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
paid_plans.notes: Full enterprise Graph integration, Teams integration, and enterprise security.

name: DeepSeek Chat
tagline: Open-weights reasoning model delivering cost-efficient, state-of-the-art chat and reasoning.
definition: DeepSeek Chat is a high-performance open-weights AI assistant developed by DeepSeek. Powered by architecture innovations like DeepSeek-V3 and DeepSeek-R1, it provides advanced step-by-step reasoning, mathematical problem solving, and coding assistance at extremely low inference costs.
why_it_matters: DeepSeek disrupted the AI industry by demonstrating that open-weights reasoning models trained with reinforcement learning can match or exceed proprietary frontier models at a fraction of the compute and API cost.
workplace_use_cases: Solving complex mathematical proofs and algorithmic coding challenges
Performing step-by-step logical reasoning and formal verification
Conducting cost-effective automated code refactoring and translation
Deploying open-weights models locally on private enterprise infrastructure
how_to_use: Visit chat.deepseek.com or connect via API to test DeepSeek-R1 reasoning models directly in your browser or local development workflow.
key_features: DeepSeek-R1 step-by-step visible chain-of-thought reasoning
Exceptional performance on coding, math, and logic benchmarks
Open-weights availability for self-hosted enterprise deployments
Ultra-low API token pricing

pricing.free_tier_details: Free web interface with access to DeepSeek-V3 and DeepSeek-R1 reasoning models.

paid_plans.name: API Pay-as-you-go
paid_plans.notes: Extremely economical API pricing for developer integration.

name: Poe by Quora
tagline: Multi-model AI ecosystem allowing users to query, compare, and build custom bots across top models.
definition: Poe is an AI platform created by Quora that provides a unified conversational workspace for chatting with GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, Gemini 1.5, Llama 3, and custom user-created bots.
why_it_matters: Poe offers a single subscription point for accessing all leading proprietary and open AI models, plus a creator monetization program.
workplace_use_cases: Comparing output responses between Claude 3.5 Sonnet and GPT-4o on identical prompts
Building custom enterprise prompt bots for internal team workflows
Accessing niche fine-tuned models for specific programming languages
how_to_use: Sign up at poe.com, choose a model bot from the sidebar, and enter your prompt.
key_features: Access to Claude 3.5, GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Llama 3, and SDXL
Custom bot creation with prompt instructions or server API webhooks
Monetization creator program for popular bot developers

pricing.free_tier_details: Daily free point allowance for basic model queries.

paid_plans.name: Poe Subscription
paid_plans.notes: 1,000,000 monthly compute points for premium models.

name: You.com
tagline: AI search assistant offering customizable mode switching for research, coding, and creative writing.
definition: You.com is a personalized AI assistant and search platform that provides mode switching (Smart, Genius, Research, Creative) to answer questions with live web grounding.
why_it_matters: You.com gives users direct control over computational depth, allowing them to route queries to multi-step reasoning models with live web citation links.
workplace_use_cases: Switching to Genius mode for multi-step math and coding execution
Searching current tech news with real-time web citations
Generating marketing copy with Creative mode
how_to_use: Visit you.com, select your desired search mode, and type your research query.
key_features: Genius Mode for multi-step reasoning and data analysis
Model selection between GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, and Llama 3
Source citation links and web privacy protection

pricing.free_tier_details: Unlimited standard queries on Smart mode.

paid_plans.name: YouPro
paid_plans.notes: Unlimited Genius and Research queries, top model selection.

name: Le Chat (Mistral AI)
tagline: European frontier AI conversational assistant powered by Mistral Large and Pixtral models.
definition: Le Chat is the official conversational interface from Mistral AI, a leading European open-weights AI laboratory. It provides fast reasoning, multilingual text processing, and image analysis.
why_it_matters: Le Chat represents a sovereign European AI alternative that enforces strict data privacy while delivering benchmark performance on par with US frontier models.
workplace_use_cases: Processing European multilingual documentation across French, German, Spanish, and English
Conducting concise technical writing and code refactoring
Analyzing image inputs and document uploads
how_to_use: Go to chat.mistral.ai, sign in, select Mistral Large or Pixtral, and enter your prompt.
key_features: Mistral Large 2 model with 128k context window
Pixtral vision-language model for image processing
Multilingual fluency across 20+ languages
Strict GDPR compliance and data sovereignty focus

pricing.free_tier_details: Free access to Le Chat with standard rate limits.

paid_plans.name: Pro / API Usage
paid_plans.notes: Commercial API access per million tokens.

name: Pi by Inflection
tagline: Empathetic, highly conversational personal AI designed for thoughtful dialogue and coaching.
definition: Pi (Personal Intelligence) is an AI assistant developed by Inflection AI. Designed to be supportive, empathetic, and conversational, it excels at back-and-forth dialogue, ideation, and verbal coaching.
why_it_matters: Pi broke ground in conversational AI design by prioritizing emotional intelligence, natural dialogue flow, and natural human-like voice synthesis.
workplace_use_cases: Practicing difficult workplace conversation scenarios and interview prep
Brainstorming creative ideas through reflective back-and-forth dialogue
Unwinding and talking through complex project problems
how_to_use: Visit pi.ai or download the Pi app, choose a voice persona, and start talking.
key_features: Highly realistic, expressive voice synthesis options
Empathetic, inquiry-driven dialogue style
Cross-platform voice call synchronization

pricing.free_tier_details: Free forever for personal conversational chat.
